parts.label: (a)
parts.text: From Source 1, identify the percentage of companies that allow remote working.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: From Source 2, identify two benefits of remote working for companies.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Which benefit of remote working do you think is the most important? Explain why.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Explain why the growth of remote working is an important worldwide trend.

parts.text:
‘Remote working should be a global priority.’
What are the strengths and weaknesses of the argument supporting this claim?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Remote working improves our health.’
How could you test this claim?
You should consider the types of information, sources of evidence and methods you might
use.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Identify one prediction from Jago’s statement. Explain why it is a prediction.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Identify one opinion from Lucia’s statement. Explain why it is an opinion.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Identify an example of vested interest in Lucia’s statement.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Which argument is more convincing, Jago’s or Lucia’s?
Your answer should consider both arguments and you should support your point of view with
their words.
You should also consider:
• the strength of their reasoning and evidence
• their use of language
• the different kinds of information used.

text: ‘All employees should be encouraged to work remotely.’
Do you agree with this statement?
• give reasons and evidence to support your opinion
• use the material in the sources and/or any of your own ideas
